title: Unbounded amplitude and coproducts of finite etale compact supports
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic $p>0$, let $\ell\ne p$ be prime, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. No separatedness of $X$ or $Y$ over $k$ is assumed. Fix a compactification $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{r}Y$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Let $C$ be a finite commutative ring annihilated by a power of $\ell$. On the ordinary unbounded etale derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},C)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], put $F=Rr_*j_!$.

The schemes $X,Y,\overline X$ are Noetherian, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. There exists $d\ge0$ bounding the dimensions of all geometric fibres of $f$ [def-weil-geometric-fibre], independently of $C$. The functor $F$ is exact as a triangulated functor and preserves arbitrary set-indexed coproducts [def-weil-triangulated-category]. For every integer $b$, it sends $D^{\ge b}$ into $D^{\ge b}$. For every geometric fibre bound $d\ge0$ and every integer $a$, it sends $D^{\le a}$ into $D^{\le a+2d}$, where the bounds are those of [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. In particular $F(D^{[a,b]})\subset D^{[a,b+2d]}$ for every $a\le b$. These assertions include the empty source or target, with $d=0$ allowed in that case.

source.place: Corollary 2.19, printed p. 12: unbounded amplitude of compact supports; retained item proof steps 1–3 supply the geometric bound, lower bound, and telescope argument.

proof.text: Use finite type over Spec k to obtain local Noetherianity and compactness for X and Y; properness gives these for the compactification ambient. Local Noetherianity gives quasi-separatedness. Apply the geometry lemma to Y over the dimension-zero field point and then to f, obtaining a uniform geometric-fibre dimension bound before choosing coefficients.

The exact extension by zero and the unbounded right-derived pushforward are triangulated. The existing source derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction is the derived adjunction of the exact open-extension/restriction pair; the left-adjoint colimit theorem supplies coproduct preservation in every indexing universe. Proper pushforward preserves arbitrary coproducts by the proper coproduct theorem; compose the two functors. Their Grothendieck and K-injective structures are the existing source instances.

Apply the existing isGE_mapDerivedCategory_obj for exact extension by zero, then isGE_rightDerivedFunctor_obj for ordinary etale derived direct image. The latter uses the existing bounded-below representative and K-injective compatibility argument, with no upper bound on the input.

The prime l is nonzero in k: otherwise p divides l, forcing p=1 or p=l, both excluded. Map its inverse from k to global sections of Spec k and then to Y, obtaining invertibility of the coefficient exponent. Apply the sharp heart bound and transfer from its chosen compactification to c using the existing rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlusιIso. Combine its upper bound with step 3 and apply bounded_heart_amplitude with the class of all sheaves.

Use the existing source coarse uniform upper bound N. For K≤a set m=min(a,a+2d−N), and apply F to the distinguished triangle τ_{<m}K→K→τ_{≥m}K. The first image lies in D^{≤m−1+N}, hence in D^{≤a+2d}. The third input lies in [m,a], so the bounded-heart bound places its image in D^{≤a+2d}. The extension-closed property of the standard t-structure bounds the middle image. This avoids all sequential homotopy-colimit constructions. Combine with the lower bound for the interval assertion; all arguments include zero objects, empty schemes, d=0, and the zero ring.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q63-cea487358 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item, all 6 stmt_deps and 24 proof_deps statements, and Zheng Cor. 2.19 with its proof (p.12) and Prop. 2.23 (p.14). The statement matches Cor. 2.19 for finite ℓ-power-torsion C with F=Rr_*j_! on unbounded ordinary étale D. No new nodes, no SGA, no cycle. Step 1: the cbc fibre-bound lemma, applied to X,Y→Spec k, r and f, gives Noetherian schemes and a geometric-fibre bound d; locally Noetherian gives quasi-separated. Step 2: j_! is exact and a left adjoint, the exact-derived-coproducts lemma lifts coproducts to D, lem-amb-proper-coproducts applies (r proper, Noetherian, C finite), and the composite is triangulated. Step 3: a representative zero below b, the D+ injective representative (K-injective) computing Rr_*, then r_* termwise. Step 4: lem-dg-compact-support-amplitude (exponent of C divides ℓ^s, invertible since ℓ≠p; its f_! is the def-amb candidate, which is our F) with step 3 gives [0,2d] on module sheaves; bounded-heart amplitude with S = all sheaves gives D^{[u,a]}→D^{[u,a+2d]}. Steps 5-6: brutal-truncation telescope (kun complex-colimit hocolim, functor-preserves-hocolim); countable sums are exact and homology commutes with them; the long exact sequence bounds H^i(FK) for i>a+2d. Edge cases checked: d=0, X empty with nonempty boundary, C=0 and Z/ℓ^s, nonseparated bases, unbounded inputs. No duplicate in the DAG. All off-unit citations are declared tool_uses and are generic; I accept them. Batch-5: both lem-amb-proper-coproducts and lem-dg-compact-support-amplitude reach lem-pod-lisse-module-sheaves-as-module-objects only through ordinary proper base change (thm-weil-pbc-bounded-below). That node is generic lisse-sheaf/module-object algebra, not part of the trace formula or Poincaré duality, and the two cited results are cd/coproduct facts outside both assumptions, so I accept both. No fixes.
